Industry observers note that "La giudice per le indagini preliminari del Tribunale di Monza Letizia Anna Brambilla ha archiviato l'inchiesta per concorso in frode sportiva sulle presunte “bussate” nella sala Var di Lissone tra il 2024 e il 2025". La giudice ha accolto in toto le argomentazioni della Procura di Monza, che aveva chiesto di non procedere nei confronti del designatore arbitrale e supervisore Gianluca Rocchi, del supervisore degli ufficiali di gara addetti al Var Andrea Gervasoni e degli arbitri addetti al Var Luigi Nasca e Rodolfo Di Vuolo.

Scegli Fcinter1908.it come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui.

In a recent development, si legge sul sito del quotidiano Il Giorno che per primo aveva parlato anche delle richieste di archiviazioni del Tribunale di Milano. Il procedimento era arrivato a Monza per competenza territoriale e ipotizzava alterazioni durante la partita tra Inter e Hellas Verona del 6 gennaio 2024. Nasca e Di Vuolo erano indagati per la mancata raccomandazione di una on field review nell'azione che precedette la rete del 2-1". Rocchi era indagato per le famose bussate durante Udinese-Parma e Gervasoni per un presunto condizionamento in Salernitana-Modena.

Santini e Gittardi, i due pm che si sono occupati della vicenda hanno evidenzato, da come riporta il quotidiano: "criticità istituzionali e organizzative nel settore arbitrale, segnato da tensioni interne, contrapposizioni sulla governance, perplessità sulla regolamentazione della sala Var e rischi derivanti dalla promiscuità dei rapporti tra organi arbitrali, federazione e società calcistiche. Profili che possono - al limite ed eventualmente - assumere rilievo in altre sedi, disciplinare, regolamentare o politico-sportivo, ma non risultano sufficienti a fondare l'esercizio dell'azione penale per frode sportiva".

Breaking: Après 7 défaites en 10 matchs de Premier League, c'est désormais officiel : Crystal Palace vire Pierre Sage !

📅 12 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (467 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Le10sport

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • In a recent development, moins de cinq mois après sa nomination à Crystal Palace, Pierre Sage a été officiellement démis de ses fonctions ce jeudi 12 novembre 2026.
  • Sources indicate that pierre Sage n'aura pas résisté au revers concédé à domicile contre Liverpool (1-3), le dimanche 8 novembre 2026 à Selhurst Park, signant une quatrième défaite de rang en championnat.
  • Industry observers note that la situation n'était guère plus brillante sur la scène continentale.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, moins de cinq mois après sa nomination à Crystal Palace, Pierre Sage a été officiellement démis de ses fonctions ce jeudi 12 novembre 2026. L'entraîneur français de 47 ans paie un début de saison désastreux en Premier League, laissant le club londonien à la dernière place du championnat.

Sources indicate that pierre Sage n'aura pas résisté au revers concédé à domicile contre Liverpool (1-3), le dimanche 8 novembre 2026 à Selhurst Park, signant une quatrième défaite de rang en championnat. En dix journées de Premier League sous les ordres de Pierre Sage, le bilan comptable est accablant avec 7 défaites, 1 match nul et seulement 2 victoires, soit 7 petits points pris sur 30 possibles. Crystal Palace occupe ainsi la 20e et dernière place du classement, à deux longueurs du premier non-relégable. Une situation critique.

Industry observers note that la situation n'était guère plus brillante sur la scène continentale. En Ligue Europa, les Eagles pointent au 21e rang de la phase de ligue avec une seule victoire en quatre rencontres. Au total, Pierre Sage n'aura dirigé que 16 matches sur le banc de Crystal Palace toutes compétitions confondues avant son licenciement.

Sources indicate that sur le terrain, la méthode du coach français n'a jamais fonctionné. L'application stricte d'un bloc haut a constamment exposé son arrière-garde, faisant de Crystal Palace la pire défense d'Angleterre avec 24 buts encaissés en 10 matches de championnat. Le mandat de Pierre Sage a notamment été marqué par une lourde défaite (5-0) subie en octobre 2026 face au rival historique Brighton. Un naufrage tactique.

Toutefois, l'effectif a également pâti des départs estivaux non compensés de Maxence Lacroix et Marc Guéhi en défense centrale, dans un contexte de recrutement restreint par une direction plus économe. La succession d'Oliver Glasner s'annonçait d'ailleurs périlleuse, l'Autrichien étant devenu l'idole des supporters après ses victoires en FA Cup et au Community Shield en 2025, puis en Ligue Conférence, avant de rejoindre Nottingham Forest.

In a recent development, cette éviction intervient alors que Pierre Sage sortait d'une saison brillante au RC Lens, couronnée du titre de meilleur entraîneur de Ligue 1, d'une victoire en Coupe de France et d'une 2e place en championnat. Selon L'Équipe, le technicien pourrait rebondir sans tarder dans le Nord. Il figure parmi les pistes explorées par les dirigeants artésiens, aux côtés de Didier Digard et Thiago Motta, pour succéder à Yannick Cahuzac, limogé en début de semaine.

It has been revealed that de son côté, Crystal Palace négocie activement avec l'entraîneur danois Thomas Frank pour reprendre l'équipe. Les Eagles tenteront de se relancer lors de leur prochain match, programmé le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 15h00 face à Coventry City à la Coventry Building Society Arena, pour le compte de la 11e journée de Premier League.

« Il m’appelait tous les jours » : Thierry Henry déballe tout sur Michael Olise !

📅 12 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (650 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Le10sport

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Invité dans le podcast Kampo animé par le journaliste Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry s'est longuement livré sur les coulisses des Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024.
  • According to recent reports, en 2024 la confection de la liste pour les Jeux Olympiques de Paris avait rapidement viré au casse-tête pour le sélectionneur tricolore.
  • L'attaquant a fait le forcing pour s'assurer une place dans le groupe olympique.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Invité dans le podcast Kampo animé par le journaliste Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry s'est longuement livré sur les coulisses des Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. L'ancien sélectionneur de l'équipe de France olympique a révélé la détermination totale de Michael Olise pour disputer le tournoi sous le maillot tricolore.

According to recent reports, en 2024 la confection de la liste pour les Jeux Olympiques de Paris avait rapidement viré au casse-tête pour le sélectionneur tricolore. Le tournoi olympique de football n'étant pas inscrit sur les dates officielles du calendrier de la FIFA, les clubs professionnels n'avaient aucune obligation légale de libérer leurs joueurs. Cette absence de contrainte réglementaire avait grandement compliqué la tâche de Thierry Henry pour composer son groupe. Face à ces nombreux refus, Michael Olise a adopté une démarche diamétralement opposée.

L'attaquant a fait le forcing pour s'assurer une place dans le groupe olympique. Alors que Gareth Southgate souhaitait le convoquer avec les A de l'équipe d'Angleterre pour disputer l'Euro 2024, Michael Olise a écarté cette opportunité pour privilégier le maillot tricolore. Le joueur a ainsi multiplié les appels téléphoniques directs avec le sélectionneur français. Dans le podcast Kampo animé par Smaïl Bouabdellah, Thierry Henry a détaillé cette insistance quotidienne : « Michael, il m’appelait tous les jours pour aller aux JO, alors qu’il y avait l’équipe d’Angleterre qui le voulait pour aller au Championnat d’Europe avec les A. Il aurait pu aller à l’Euro avec l’Angleterre. Mais il m’appelait tous les jours. Son envie de jouer pour l’équipe de France était extraordinaire. Moi, je n’ai convaincu personne. ».

Né à Londres en 2001 d'un père nigérian et d'une mère franco-algérienne, Michael Olise disposait sur le plan sportif de plusieurs options internationales. L'attaquant était éligible pour quatre sélections nationales différentes : la France, l'Angleterre, le Nigeria et l'Algérie. Toutefois, Michael Olise a toujours accordé sa préférence absolue à l'équipe de France. Au-delà des approches anglaises, le joueur a fait preuve d'une fermeté totale au moment de quitter Crystal Palace pour rejoindre l'Allemagne.

Sources indicate that recruté par le Bayern Munich pour 53 millions d'euros selon Foot Mercato, et plus de 60 millions d'euros d'après d'autres sources, il a imposé sa participation aux Jeux Olympiques de Paris 2024. Le joueur a ainsi pris le risque de se heurter à sa nouvelle direction bavaroise pour défendre les couleurs tricolores. Thierry Henry a salué cette prise de position au micro de Smaïl Bouabdellah : « Michael Olise aime l’équipe de France depuis qu’il est petit. Certains joueurs ne voulaient pas venir. Pas de problème, je n’en veux à personne. Mais un mec de ce calibre est venu, alors qu’il y avait le risque de s’embrouiller avec son nouveau club. Il m’a dit: 'Où je vais, je vais dire à mon club que je vais aux Jeux olympiques, c’est tout.’ On parle de Michael Olise. Mon respect pour lui est énorme. ».

According to recent reports, sur le terrain, ce choix a porté ses fruits tout au long de la compétition estivale. Titulaire lors des 6 matches du tournoi olympique, Michael Olise a compilé 2 buts et 5 passes décisives sous les ordres de Thierry Henry. Ce parcours s'est achevé par une médaille d'argent décrochée le 9 août 2024 au Parc des Princes, après une finale disputée contre l'Espagne (3-5 après prolongation).

In a recent development, au-delà de ce bilan chiffré, Thierry Henry qualifie Michael Olise de génie qu'il ne faut pas brider. Dans le podcast Kampo, l'ancien joueur d'Arsenal a ainsi développé son analyse sur le talent de son ancien joueur : « Michael, il est à part parce qu’il pense différemment. À un moment donné, les génies, il ne faut pas essayer de les comprendre. C’est un génie ? Ah, de très loin, très très loin. (…) Est-ce que tu vas, toi, dire à un peintre comment peindre ? Pourquoi tu veux bloquer un génie ? ».

« Il a haussé le ton » : Zinédine Zidane a secoué les Bleus !

📅 16 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (868 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Le10sport

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that bousculée et imprécise lors du premier acte dimanche soir, l'équipe de France a affiché un tout autre visage après la pause face à la Turquie.
  • Industry observers note that dimanche 15 novembre, les Bleus disputaient la 6e et dernière journée de la Ligue des nations face à la Turquie au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux.
  • According to recent reports, dans le vestiaire tricolore, Zinédine Zidane a recadré ses joueurs, sans pour autant céder à une colère excessive.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that bousculée et imprécise lors du premier acte dimanche soir, l'équipe de France a affiché un tout autre visage après la pause face à la Turquie. Un sursaut salutaire provoqué par Zinédine Zidane, qui n'a pas hésité à hausser le ton dans le vestiaire.

Industry observers note that dimanche 15 novembre, les Bleus disputaient la 6e et dernière journée de la Ligue des nations face à la Turquie au stade Atlantique de Bordeaux. Trois jours après le revers concédé face à l'Italie à San Siro, premier accroc de l'ère Zinédine Zidane, les Tricolores se devaient de réagir. Toutefois, à la pause, le score restait nul et vierge (0-0), actant un dixième match de suite sans marquer lors du premier acte. Un manque d'efficacité chronique qui a fini par agacer le sélectionneur.

According to recent reports, dans le vestiaire tricolore, Zinédine Zidane a recadré ses joueurs, sans pour autant céder à une colère excessive. Le sélectionneur souhaitait corriger l'apathie collective et le manque d'agressivité à la perte du ballon constatés durant le premier acte. Une mise au point nécessaire pour relancer son équipe. Au micro de TF1 après la rencontre, le défenseur de Liverpool Jérémy Jacquet a ainsi dévoilé la teneur du discours : « Le coach nous a dit à la mi-temps qu’il trouvait qu’on n’était pas assez agressifs à la perte du ballon. On l’a bien rectifié en deuxième. […] Pour être honnête, il n’a pas gueulé, mais a haussé le ton sur nos axes de progression à la perte de balle. Pour lui, on pouvait faire mieux. Il trouvait qu’on gardait trop le ballon et voulait que l’on bouge plus. ».

De son côté, le technicien tricolore a confirmé avoir bousculé ses troupes tout en restant mesuré, préférant insister sur les ajustements tactiques exigés sur la pelouse. « Ce n'est pas la défense. C'est tous ensemble. On doit aller presser tous ensemble et quand on ne presse pas, on se resserre tous ensemble. C'est des choses qu'on doit mettre en place. On a besoin de garder le ballon. On aime courir avec ballon, sans ballon, ce n'est pas notre truc. On l'a mieux en seconde période en jouant en deux touches. On doit le répéter. Les murs n’ont pas tremblé à la mi-temps. On a rectifié des choses et c’était mieux en seconde. La réaction était très bonne », a détaillé Zinédine Zidane sur TF1.

Industry observers note that en effet, la copie rendue au cours des quarante-cinq premières minutes a déçu le patron des Bleus. Malgré une possession de balle établie à 60 %, la France n'a jamais su emballer la rencontre, gaspillant de l'énergie à courir après le cuir tout en concédant de larges décalages. Le pressing tricolore s'est révélé particulièrement inefficace. Sur le plateau de TF1, Zinédine Zidane a ainsi exprimé sa frustration : « C'était l'objectif de se qualifier, en étant éventuellement premier. Par contre, sur le contenu, on peut être un peu perplexe, surtout dans notre pression en première mi-temps. Quand on ne voit pas certaines choses sur le terrain, on est un peu frustrés. C'est surtout dans la pression, parce qu'on laissait faire les décalages et on n'a pas été bons du tout dans notre pression. On a rectifié ça à la mi-temps et on a été meilleurs après. Ce sont des choses où on doit encore s'améliorer. Moi, je n'étais pas content, les joueurs non plus. Mais on a rectifié. ».

According to recent reports, D'ailleurs, le sélectionneur a réitéré son agacement en conférence de presse d'après-match pour cibler ce dysfonctionnement inhabituel. Pour Zinédine Zidane, son équipe a été défaillante dans sa première ligne de récupération en concédant bien trop de liberté à l'adversaire : « Ce qui n’a pas été bon, c’est notre première pression. On l’a très bien fait sur les cinq autres matchs, même contre l’Italie. En revanche, ce soir, on a été défaillants, notamment en première mi-temps. On a laissé beaucoup trop d’espaces. On a rectifié le tir en deuxième mi-temps où on a été très bons dans l’utilisation du ballon. Même si on peut encore mieux faire, parce que j’ai des joueurs de qualité qui peuvent garder le ballon. Ce sont eux (les Turcs) qui doivent courir derrière le ballon », a insisté Zinédine Zidane.

According to recent reports, au retour des vestiaires, le discours du sélectionneur a porté ses fruits. Nettement plus agressifs et tranchants en jouant en deux touches de balle, les Bleus ont rapidement trouvé la faille sur un but contre son camp d'Emirhan Topçu (49e). Lancés, les Tricolores ont ensuite fait le break grâce à Éli Junior Kroupi (79e). La réduction du score tardive d'Abdülkerim Bardakcı (89e) n'a rien changé à l'problem de la rencontre (2-1). Une réaction salutaire.

Ainsi, ce succès combiné à la défaite de l'Italie contre la Belgique (1-4) permet à la France de terminer à la première place de sa poule. Les hommes de Zinédine Zidane valident officiellement leur qualification pour les quarts de finale du Final 8 de la Ligue des nations. Les Bleus connaîtront leur prochain adversaire lors du tirage au sort programmé le vendredi 20 novembre 2026 en Suisse, avant d'aborder cette double confrontation en mars 2027.

Lors de cette 6e et dernière journée, les Bleus ont marqué un premier but grâce à une réalisation contre son camp d'Emirhan Topçu à la 49e minute, puis un deuxième avec Éli Junior Kroupi à la 80e minute, avant la réduction du score turque par Abdülkerim Bardakcı à la 90e minute. Le coup de sifflet final a retenti à 22h38. Une fin de soirée agitée.

According to recent reports, À 22h40, les Bleus ont effectué un timide tour d'honneur autour du rond central plutôt qu'autour du terrain, sans plusieurs cadres dont le capitaine Kylian Mbappé qui avait déjà quitté la pelouse. D'ailleurs, la distance entre les joueurs et les tribunes lors de ce tour d'honneur a provoqué quelques sifflets de supporters français déçus.

En effet, les départs se sont enchaînés à toute vitesse. Kylian Mbappé a quitté le stade Atlantique à 22h53, soit exactement quinze minutes après le coup de sifflet final, plusieurs témoins évoquant un joueur très pressé. Rayan Cherki et Malo Gusto ont ensuite quitté le stade ensemble valise à la main, suivis par Eduardo Camavinga. Une course contre la montre.

Et pour cause, la fermeture avancée de l'aéroport de Bordeaux-Mérignac imposait un timing très serré. Plusieurs avions privés étaient ainsi prévus au décollage : un jet pour Milan à 00h05 et un autre pour Madrid à 00h12. De son côté, l'avion de la Fédération Française de Football a quitté la Gironde à 1h15.

It has been revealed that passés en zone d'interviews, Andy Diouf et Pablo Pagis ont tous les deux confirmé l'absence de discours de Zinédine Zidane dans le vestiaire. « On n’a pas fait de discours », a déclaré Andy Diouf devant les micros. De son côté, Pablo Pagis a détaillé la gestion du sélectionneur tricolore : « Il a laissé tout le monde tranquille ».

Zinédine Zidane n'a pas retenu ses joueurs pressés en raison de la fatigue et du calendrier très serré de ce rassemblement de novembre, qui comptait deux matches en 72 heures.

According to recent reports, au-delà de cette fin de soirée au pas de course dans les couloirs du stade bordelais, les Tricolores ont validé leur qualification. Le prochain rendez-vous des Bleus de Zidane est fixé du 25 au 30 mars 2027 pour les quarts de finale aller-retour de la Ligue des nations.

It has been revealed that ciblé par de vives critiques après la récente défaite du Brésil, Carlo Ancelotti a réagi ce lundi avec une fermeté inhabituelle. Le sélectionneur de la Seleção a sèchement répondu aux attaques de Romario, qui réclamait publiquement son départ immédiat.

It has been revealed that la tension est montée d'un cran autour de la sélection brésilienne depuis le revers concédé face au Japon (3-2), samedi 14 novembre 2026, au Stade national de Singapour. Alors que les Japonais menaient rapidement grâce à Takefusa Kubo et Keito Nakamura, le doublé de Vinícius Júnior (33e, 75e) avait pourtant permis aux Auriverdes d'égaliser. Toutefois, le but concédé à Tatsuhiro Sakamoto (91e) dans le temps additionnel a scellé la défaite brésilienne.

It has been revealed that présent en conférence de presse d'avant-match à Singapour, Carlo Ancelotti a été invité à réagir aux attaques formulées par l'ancien attaquant de la Seleção. Le technicien italien a répondu en espagnol à l'ancien international. Une mise au point limpide. « C'est la liberté d'expression et, dans un pays démocratique, tout le monde peut avoir une opinion. Romario a donné la sienne, et tout le monde a le droit de dire des mensonges, des vérités ou des bêtises. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que Romario parle beaucoup, et il est dans son droit », a ainsi rétorqué l'entraîneur face aux journalistes.

In a recent development, cette sortie directe démontre la volonté du sélectionneur de balayer la polémique alors que la pression médiatique s'accentue. Carlo Ancelotti n'a pas souhaité polémiquer davantage avec l'ancienne gloire du football brésilien, se contentant de souligner avec ironie l'omniprésence médiatique de son détracteur.

Sources indicate that deux jours plus tôt, Romario n'avait pas mâché ses mots à la suite de la défaite concédée face à l'équipe nippone. L'ancien buteur brésilien avait réclamé la destitution immédiate du sélectionneur sur ses réseaux sociaux, estimant qu'Ancelotti ne disposait pas des qualités requises pour diriger le pays. « Ça suffit ! Prends tes affaires et va-t'en ! », avait notamment écrit Romario, très remonté contre l'entraîneur italien.

Au-delà de cette interpellation, Romario a tout de même reconnu les accomplissements passés de Carlo Ancelotti, qualifié d'« un des grands entraîneurs » en club, tout en appelant à son retour sur le Vieux Continent : « Retourne dans les clubs, où tu t'es fait un nom, car la sélection brésilienne ne peut pas continuer à prendre ce risque ». L'ancien international a également interpellé le président de la Confédération brésilienne de football (CBF), Samir Xaud, affirmant qu'il fallait désormais « le courage de prendre une décision ». Cette attaque fait suite à une fin de match sous haute tension contre le Japon, au cours de laquelle Carlo Ancelotti et l'attaquant Raphinha avaient été expulsés pour avoir protesté contre une faute présumée au départ de la troisième réalisation adverse.

Lucide quant au niveau affiché par ses joueurs sur le terrain, Carlo Ancelotti n'a éludé aucune question sur les difficultés actuelles de la Seleção. Lors de son point presse, le coach italien a dressé une autocritique sans concession sur le rendement de son groupe. « Je dois faire plus et je vais le faire. J'aime être ici, j'aime être dans la sélection nationale et je dois m'améliorer. Je dois faire plus pour que la sélection redevienne compétitive. Il y a longtemps que nous ne sommes plus compétitifs », a déclaré le technicien italien.

Toutefois, le sélectionneur brésilien a insisté sur la nature amicale de cette rencontre et la nécessité de renouveler son effectif en vue des futures échéances. « C'est évident que c'est le moment des essais. Nous essayons de nouveaux joueurs, en commençant par Gabriel Bontempo, André, Jonathan Jesus... Ce sont des évaluations très positives, sans mentionner de noms. Nous espérons toujours bien jouer, mais il est incompatible d'essayer, de renouveler et d'avoir l'équipe prête. Nous continuons avec une grande confiance dans cette voie et nous nous testerons contre Singapour », a détaillé le sélectionneur brésilien.

It has been revealed that après ce premier revers en Asie, le Brésil doit désormais se remobiliser pour son second match amical de la trêve internationale, prévu le mardi 17 novembre 2026 au Stade national de Singapour face à Singapour. Une rencontre que Carlo Ancelotti devra observer loin de la pelouse : le technicien italien est suspendu de banc de touche suite à son expulsion contre le Japon et ne pourra pas diriger directement ses hommes au bord du terrain. L'équipe devra également composer sans son attaquant Raphinha, lui aussi sous le coup d'une suspension. Pour animer son secteur offensif face aux Singapouriens, Carlo Ancelotti a d'ores et déjà annoncé la titularisation du jeune avant-centre Endrick pour le match du mardi 17 novembre 2026.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It has been revealed that C'est une annonce majeure pour le football belge en ce lundi 16 novembre 2026. Sur son compte Instagram, Romelu Lukaku a officialisé son départ définitif de la sélection des Diables Rouges après seize années passées au plus haut niveau international.

L'attaquant de 33 ans a surpris l'ensemble des observateurs au lendemain de la victoire de la Belgique face à l'Italie (4-1) en Ligue des nations, qui a validé la qualification des Diables Rouges pour les quarts de finale du tournoi. Dimanche 15 novembre 2026, Romelu Lukaku est resté sur le banc des remplaçants sans entrer en jeu, après avoir manqué le match précédent face à la Turquie en raison d'une légère blessure à la hanche. Pour accompagner son message d'adieu sur le réseau social, le joueur a publié une galerie photo retraçant son parcours international depuis ses débuts en mars 2010 à l'âge de 16 ans. Plusieurs coéquipiers emblématiques de la génération dorée, dont Axel Witsel et Thibaut Courtois, ont d'ailleurs salué publiquement sa carrière sous sa publication. Une page se tourne pour les Diables Rouges.

En quittant la sélection, Romelu Lukaku laisse un héritage statistique considérable. L'avant-centre se retire en effet en tant que meilleur buteur absolu de l'histoire de la sélection belge avec 94 buts inscrits en 135 sélections. Au niveau des apparitions, le joueur n'est devancé que par Jan Vertonghen (157 sélections) et Axel Witsel (140 sélections). Pilier de la sélection durant plus d'une décennie, il a disputé quatre phases finales de Coupe du monde (2014, 2018 avec une 3e place, 2022 et 2026) ainsi que trois Championnats d'Europe (2016, 2020 et 2024). Son dernier match officiel sous le maillot des Diables Rouges remonte ainsi au 5 octobre 2026 contre l'équipe de France en Ligue des nations, lors d'une défaite (1-4).

Industry observers note that cette annonce constitue d'ailleurs un revirement par rapport aux aims initialement affichés par l'intéressé. En effet, l'attaquant avait affirmé en janvier 2026 que la Coupe du monde 2026 ne marquerait pas sa dernière compétition majeure avec la Belgique. La sélection des Diables Rouges a elle aussi tenu à rendre hommage à son avant-centre sur son compte officiel X, saluant un joueur qui a écrit un incroyable chapitre de l'histoire de l'équipe nationale.

Industry observers note that la situation sportive de l'attaquant s'était toutefois compliquée lors des dernières semaines avec les Diables Rouges. Depuis la prise de fonction de Mark van Bommel comme sélectionneur en août 2026 en remplacement de Rudi Garcia, Romelu Lukaku a vu son temps de jeu diminuer au profit de Charles De Ketelaere. Resté sur le banc lors du récent succès face à l'Italie, le joueur a finalement choisi de renoncer aux prochaines échéances internationales de son pays. En effet, la Belgique disputera les quarts de finale de la Ligue des nations du 25 au 30 mars 2027, dont le tirage au sort est fixé au vendredi 20 novembre 2026 à Nyon.

Toutefois, cette retraite internationale ne met absolument pas un terme à sa carrière en club. Romelu Lukaku évolue sous les couleurs de Fenerbahçe depuis le mois d'août 2026 et reste concentré sur ses objectifs en Turquie. L'attaquant disputera ainsi son prochain match officiel le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 17h00 face à Kocaelispor en Süper Lig.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Erling Haaland revealed on the eve of this clash how he loves chopping firewood in his spare time – and his goals set alight Manchester City’s Champions League campaign on a fractious evening in Porto.

So much for the fresh group stage of the competition taking time to warm up. This clash was a hot-blooded, bitter contest that spilt over in the tunnel at half-time, with players getting separated and tempers rising.

Recent findings suggest that and City were not easing themselves back into European action either, they went full throttle at the start of a tough set of group games. With Enzo Maresca, it looks like it will be all-out attack to get the best out of this team.

They can look nervous at the back, particularly with the ball at Gianluigi Donnarumma’s feet, but have attacking weapons to hurt any team in this elite competition. This was a performance that their rivals will take note of.

“It was a complete performance on and off the ball for 95 minutes,” was Maresca’s assessment.

City will certainly scare the traditional heavyweights with Haaland leading their attack and taking an axe to Porto’s defence like he does with logs in his back garden. It was his 58th and 59th goal in 59 games in the Champions League, with his latest an expertly directed header off a post and a calm side-footed finish.

NO MISTAKE from Erling Haaland this time 💪He's put Man City 1-0 up in Porto 🇵🇹 pic.twitter.com/UpKOqQA49s.

Sources indicate that there is an argument that Pep Guardiola could have achieved more in the Champions League, given City’s dominance in domestic football. They have been knocked out by Real Madrid in the last three seasons but this is a new City, different personnel and even a new look.

They wore their black and yellow away kit, inspired by “Manchester’s iconic worker bee” according to Puma, and grafted their way to victory here. Non-stop running going forward, and scrapping with Porto, too.

Industry observers note that the Portuguese champions were not happy with Marc Guéhi’s challenge on Gabri Veiga and claimed an elbow was used, with the row carrying on in the tunnel at half-time with security guards separating the players. Rúben Dias also appeared to nudge a Porto official on his way to the dressing room.

Sources indicate that “I didn’t see anything but anyway, you can ask how many times you see me or my bench stand up? Zero, for 95 minutes. How many times do you see their bench? So...” Maresca added.

Only Dias and Haaland remain from the starting line-up from the Champions League triumph three years ago, so this is essentially a new team with a new manager.

Erling Haaland seals the deal in Porto 🤝🇵🇹 pic.twitter.com/10xSTtZ8nw.

Phil Foden, on as a sub in that game, started at Estádio do Dragão after his horse Wreck It Ronnie defeated Najidi Storm, which started the Goodwood race with 1-33 odds and is now the shortest-priced loser in British racing history. The rest of the team are upcoming to City’s challenge.

That includes Ayyoub Bouaddi, 18, who was part of a £320m midfield refresh following the departure of Rodri, who was named among the Ballon d’Or nominees a few hours before kick-off to highlight the experience and class City have lost.

It has been revealed that bouaddi, who cost £81.4m from Lille, made a good start in his full debut. The Moroccan teenager is neat on the ball and gets around the pitch, with the next step being able to dominate games like his predecessor.

Sources indicate that “In his last game he lost two balls and stayed calm and was back in our box,” Maresca said. “This indicates how good he is because any player after two [poor] passes panics, but he is just 18. Erling, Rúben, Mateo [Kovacic], they can manage these kind of games better, but you don’t expect it from a guy of 18. I didn’t see him panic.”.

Recent findings suggest that by Bouaddi’s side in midfield was Enzo Fernández, who sought to drive forward into space when City counter-attacked. He was among the players who, along with Dias, were reminded of their Benfica history by the home fans.

It has been revealed that diogo Costa tends to be linked with a move to the Premier League every summer, but has been a one-club man for his career so far. But he showed why clubs are looking at him with his first-half saves to deny Haaland and Rayan Cherki.

Porto’s legendary goalkeeper, Helton, was in the press box at half-time and would have been impressed with the saves, although he was not in his seat when Haaland scored the first goal, which came 94 seconds after the restart.

Recent findings suggest that city had worked the ball around the penalty area, with Antoine Semenyo drawing out Costa before laying off to Fernández. Haaland’s header from the cross had such precision that the goalkeeper did not dive as it angled in off a post.

Still, Porto had their chances with Alberto Costa heading wide from a corner and William Gomes charging down a Donnarumma kick – with City’s most nervous moments coming when they passed around their back line.

Recent findings suggest that man City are living dangerously here! 🫣Donnarumma nearly gifts Porto an equaliser 😬 pic.twitter.com/otIfZTHmdn.

But Haaland sealed the win as the game ticked into stoppage time, finding the bottom corner from Rayan Aït-Nouri’s cutback.

In a recent development, “It was an amazing game against the champions of Portugal. We knew it would be a difficult fight, man against man, they are a top team,” Haaland stated. “They play amazing football. All the pressure, we have to deliver on the massive stage and that’s what we did. We controlled the whole first half, created chances.”.

It has been revealed that for Maresca, the victory was also a challenge against Porto’s aggression, with the Italian coach adding: “I was very pleased. We know in this kind of game when you come here it’s always difficult or tricky. The environment, the way they grew up, it’s normal, but I think we dealt with that very good.”.

Top performance, Enzo 👊✨ pic.twitter.com/ds0f207tpS.

It has been revealed that “I think we could have scored more goals, especially in the first half. We overall deserved the win and happy with the performance. If you think you can come to a place like this and play and not concede any chances, that is not realistic and it is normal. I am quite lucky as I have a squad of good players. I am so grateful for everything he has done for me and my family.”.

That is a major chance missed by Pepe. Gimenez receives it down the left and pings a cross to the back post. The cross perfectly picks out Pepe, who fluffs his lines and completely mis-kicks.

No goals in Porto but Real Madrid have their second at home against Inter Milan through Fede Valverde.

It has been a positive start for Unai Emery’s Aston Villa out in Belgium as they lead Club Brugge 3-1 at half-time.

Enzo Maresca takes charge of his first Champions League game in charge of Manchester City as they have travelled to Portugal to take on Porto at the Estadio do Dragao. These sides last met during the Champions League group stages during the 2020/21 season. Manchester City won 3-1 at home before the two sides drew 0-0 in this stadium.

Recent findings suggest that manchester City were busy late on in the transfer window, bringing in both Iliman Ndiaye and Enzo Fernandez as they spent nearly £200m on deadline day alone. They come into tonight’s game off the back of three straight Premier League victories to kick off the Maresca era. Maresca has limited Champions League experience as a manager, which came with Chelsea last season. Manchester City have won their opening game of a Champions League campaign in six of the last seven seasons but this will be the first time since 2015/16 that Manchester City embark on a Champions League campaign without Pep Guardiola at the helm.

“It is a hard place to come [Porto],” noted Maresca. “They have started really well. In the last 14/15 games in Europe they lost just one, that shows a difficult place to come, but we will try our best and try to win the game. It is a very, very good team. They have different players, but in terms of the team it is very clear in the way they play. They are aggressive without the ball and on the ball, they have a clear style. But we will try our best and try to win the game. The ambition is the same; try to be ourselves and to win games and then we will see.”.

Sources indicate that porto, managed by Francesco Farioli, have won every league game so far this season and already sit four points clear at the summit of Liga Portugal. Farioli takes charge of his first game as a manger in the Champions League and the club make their return to the elite European competition after two seasons away.

Sources indicate that “We are going to face one of the major favourites to win the competition,” Farioli said. “It will be a game that will demand that we be at our best, and we know that whenever we step onto the Dragão pitch, something special can happen. I am happy to be in the Champions League for the first time at 37 years old. This will be my first game, but we approach every game with the same attention to detail and the same focus. It is easy for the players to be motivated tomorrow [tonight]. But the key will be our strategy and our ability to execute it, individually and collectively.”.

Porto were in the Europa League last season, making it to the quarter-finals, where they were knocked out by Nottingham Forest 2-1 on aggregate. The omens would not appear to be on Porto’s side tonight; they have only won two of their last 16 games against English opposition in major European competition.

Team news from Portugal to follow shortly.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Présent en conférence de presse ce lundi 16 novembre 2026 à Singapour, Vinicius Jr a livré une mise au point sans détour sur ses récentes difficultés avec le Real Madrid. L'attaquant brésilien a admis avoir diminué son volume d'entraînement estival, profondément affecté par l'élimination précoce de sa sélection lors de la dernière Coupe du monde.

Ce début d'exercice s'avère particulièrement difficile pour le joueur de 26 ans sous les couleurs du club espagnol. Avec un bilan de seulement un but et trois passes décisives en 12 rencontres toutes compétitions confondues avec le Real Madrid, Vinicius Jr traverse une période délicate. Un rendement bien loin de ses standards. La cause de ce passage à vide trouve son origine dans les suites de la Coupe du monde, où le Brésil a quitté la compétition dès les huitièmes de finale après une défaite face à la Norvège (2-1). Très affecté par ce revers, l'attaquant a ainsi privilégié le repos et la déconnexion en famille durant ses vacances, au détriment de sa préparation physique.

Devant les médias à Singapour, l'ailier madrilène a d'ailleurs détaillé avec franchise les raisons de ce déficit athlétique :.

Au-delà de cette déception internationale, le contexte extra-sportif n'a pas aidé le joueur du Real Madrid à aborder cette saison l'esprit totalement libéré. En effet, le dossier de sa prolongation contractuelle et les sollicitations extérieures, notamment l'intérêt de clubs comme Arsenal, ont perturbé sa concentration estivale. L'attaquant a ainsi reconnu que ces remous avaient directement influé sur son niveau de jeu depuis la reprise.

Toutefois, l'ailier madrilène a tenu à rappeler la difficulté de se maintenir au sommet dans la durée. Pour appuyer son constat, il a souligné que seuls Cristiano Ronaldo et Lionel Messi ont su afficher de telles statistiques pendant de longues années. Le numéro 7 brésilien a également rappelé son devoir d'exemplarité, affirmant être conscient que s'il court davantage, tous les jeunes joueurs courront aussi plus.

Vinicius Jr a tempéré les inquiétudes en comparant sa trajectoire à celle de la saison passée, où il ne comptait que 5 buts en décembre avant de dépasser la barre des 20 réalisations au printemps. L'attaquant reste ainsi convaincu que sa montée en puissance physique portera ses fruits au moment opportun.

Recent findings suggest that sur le plan sportif en sélection, Vinicius Jr s'est d'ailleurs redonné de la confiance en signant un doublé samedi 14 novembre 2026 lors de la défaite du Brésil contre le Japon (2-3) au Stade national de Singapour. Le Brésil dispute désormais son prochain match amical face à Singapour le mardi 17 novembre 2026 à 11h00 (heure française) au Stade national de Singapour. Le prochain rendez-vous de Vinicius Jr avec le Real Madrid est ensuite programmé le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 21h00 face au Celta Vigo au stade Santiago-Bernabéu pour la 13e journée de Liga.

Mac Allister not so sad now after Liverpool comeback winner

📅 09 Sep 2026 | ⏱️ 27 min read (5486 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~27 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Do your talking on the pitch, as the old adage goes, and Alexis Mac Allister emphatically did just that as Liverpool came from behind to thrillingly win their first Champions League tie under new head coach Andoni Iraola in what was his debut at this level.
  • On the eve of this encounter, against a strong Atlético Madrid, one of the clubs who have recently tried to sign him, Mac Allister had spoken of his sadness.
  • It has been revealed that so, earn it.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Do your talking on the pitch, as the old adage goes, and Alexis Mac Allister emphatically did just that as Liverpool came from behind to thrillingly win their first Champions League tie under new head coach Andoni Iraola in what was his debut at this level.

On the eve of this encounter, against a strong Atlético Madrid, one of the clubs who have recently tried to sign him, Mac Allister had spoken of his sadness. Sadness that, unlike fellow midfielders Dominik Szoboszlai – Liverpool’s other scorer here – and Ryan Gravenberch, he had not been offered and signed a new contract.

It has been revealed that so, earn it. And many more goals – and overall performances like this – there is no doubt the Argentinian will have a deal placed in front of him. He scored with an arresting second-half shot, which proved to be the winner, and the smile across his face remarked it all. Not so sad now as he was later substituted to a standing ovation with Gravenberch taking his place.

The goal came early in the second half, with Iraola attributing that to adjusting his tactics after being flummoxed by Atlético’s back five and packed midfield in a first half when Liverpool were second best.

Mac Allister was heavily involved through the build-up, eventually picking out Rio Ngumoha on the left whose shot was blocked and pinballed around. It dropped to Mac Allister, 20 yards out, and he hit the kind of unerring drive that gives the goalkeeper no chance. And so it proved. Boom. And Anfield was bouncing.

Sources indicate that mac Allister FIRES Liverpool into the lead at Anfield! 🔥📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/KGOvuAEU4W.

There are certainly signs under Iraola, and following a difficult last campaign, that Mac Allister is beginning to rediscover the form he highlighted during his first two seasons at Liverpool. Time and again the 27-year-old made vital interventions, showed aggression and walked the tightrope of a harsh early yellow card. He dovetailed with Szoboszlai and that might be a concern for Gravenberch – watched by the Netherlands’ new head coach Xavi Hernández – if Iraola persists with this approach.

Although Mac Allister has two years left on his current deal, the last thing Liverpool need is yet another attention-sapping contract saga, even if he is not the same scale of player as Mohamed Salah or Trent Alexander-Arnold.

For Iraola, after three Premier League games, comprising two draws and a victory over newly-promoted Ipswich Town, this will hopefully be lift off. A big European night at Anfield and coming from behind to beat one of the continent’s heavyweights.

In a recent development, “I loved it,” Iraola remarked, before castigating himself for misreading the way Atlético would line up. And what of Mac Allister’s riposte? There was a smile from Iraola before the Spaniard’s usual diplomacy kicked in as he talked about a “lovely, lovely goal” and how good it was for his midfielders to contribute.

In a recent development, liverpool had to fight for it and what will have satisfied Iraola is that the defence, which has come under such scrutiny, held out. Even so, there are still serious concerns over the suitability of Milos Kerkez at left-back – who was badly at fault for Atlético’s goal – although the robust Ronald Araújo showed he can be a strong and versatile option on the other flank. The Uruguayan, signed on loan from Barcelona, is such a presence in both penalty areas and has the capacity to gain cult status.

Sources indicate that as does £123m signing from Paris St-Germain Bradley Barcola, who should have scored – once, certainly, possibly twice – and possesses astonishing pace that will undoubtedly lead to goals. There are also encouraging signs that his presence could enliven Florian Wirtz. Barcola eventually also went off, but thankfully it was only to cramp.

There was a collective intake of breath across the Kop when Marcos Llorente was played through and bore down on them to give Atlético the lead. There was a desperate hope that he had strayed offside. There was then a realisation that Kerkez had, however, played him on with an appalling lack of awareness. Llorente beat Alisson.

It owed much to a wonderful shimmy, deceiving Szoboszlai in centre field, by Julián Alvarez before he smartly threaded the ball through, and Mac Allister’s international team-mate almost doubled Atlético’s advantage soon after. Only to be denied by Alisson.

In a recent development, llorente breaks the deadlock! 🔥That's now FIVE Champions League goals for the Atletico man against Liverpool at Anfield 🤯📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/Rxp4zurfpc.

We knew, we feared it would be Llorente who scored. Remarkably, he has now half of his 10 goals in this competition against Liverpool. Indeed, he named his dog Anfield after his extra-time brace knocked Liverpool, then the holders, out in the last 16 in 2020. And Liverpool had made a dog’s dinner of defending this time.

This is a different Atlético. A far less defensive, far more expansive Atlético. In years gone by, once they were 1-0 it was game over under Diego Simeone. But these days they try and play more and that gives their opponents a chance. And so it proved.

Atlético goalkeeper Jan Oblak did well to deny Barcola, with his trailing foot, before Wirtz won the ball back and found Szoboszlai who eventually ended the movement. It owed much, however, to a clever backheel to pick out the midfielder who finished low into the corner. Who executed that backheel? That would be Araújo.

Sources indicate that szoboszlai slots home after a brilliant flick from Araujo! 🔥📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/UrHQTwtgsY.

Barcola should have scored, sent clear by Wirtz in a brilliant, sweeping counter-attack, before Mac Allister did.

Recent findings suggest that the question now was whether Liverpool would show the resilience to see through the result. As Iraola made changes, they answered that with a resounding yes, which will have pleased him as much as the result, as much as the comeback, as much as Mac Allister’s stunning response.

According to recent reports, “I was enjoying it [the Anfield crowd]. They [Atletico Madrid] are a very good team. Technically, in the middle, lovely players. It is not easy to press those players as they have quality. They have been playing together forever. We find another comeback after Nottingham Forest, after Newcastle. We still have this thing to improve in the beginning of the games, but I am happy as we have shown some character. This is the Champions League, you do not have easy games.”.

"You can see he's football mad." ⚽Steven Gerrard on Andoni Iraola's passion and the impact he's making at Liverpool 👏🎙️ @laura_woodsy | 📺 TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/M3qKhxt8HE.

Andoni Iraola has been speaking to TNT Sports and has confirmed that it was just cramp for the likes of Bradley Barcola, rather than an injury. Milos Kerkez also went off late with what appears to be just cramp.

Atletico had more possession in the second half but Liverpool were much the better side after the break.

"We can achieve everything we want." 💪Dominik Szoboszlai full of belief after Liverpool's Champions League victory over Atletico Madrid 👀🎙️ @jules_breach | 📺 TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/ebSvagW4yx.

There is the final whistle at Anfield and Liverpool start their Champions League campaign with a 2-1 win over Atletico Madrid. Liverpool did fall behind to Marcos Llorente’s goal but goals from Dominik Szoboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister give Andoni Iraola a win in his first Champions League game as a manager.

Victory in MD1 🤩 #UCL pic.twitter.com/SWFFhSudFJ.

Industry observers note that first Champions League game. First Champions League win for Andoni Iraola ✅ pic.twitter.com/D3CE6w6V0b.

Koumas is tripped by Le Normand and that should be it.

That is a silly foul from Lookman, with Frimpong inside his own box running back towards his own goal, but Lookman decides to push him in the back.

Just 60 seconds remain at Anfield.

There will be five added minutes.

Liverpool think they have sealed it through Frimpong but the offside flag has gone up. First Munoz cuts onto his right and has a shot saved by Oblak. The ball falls to Frimpong, who slots home but he was clearly offside when Munoz took the initial shot.

Kerkez is currently down with cramp and his night is done. He will be replaced by Tsimikas and Liverpool will make their final change at the same time. Koumas comes on for Isak.

In a recent development, atletico win a corner but it all stems from sloppy play in the centre of the pitch from Gravenberch. He has had a few sloppy moments since coming on.

The corner is flicked on by Hjulmand but ends up coming to nothing.

It isn’t the headline making performance, by any means, but that shouldn’t dilute the importance of Ronald Araujo’s contribution for Liverpool tonight and, indeed, against Ipswich last Friday. He’s doing what Liverpool wanted him to, providing versatility and leadership in their back four and - more than anything - quality. He hasn’t put a foot wrong.

Atletico win a corner out on the left in front of their travelling supporters. Grimaldo’s outswinger is flicked on by the head of Hancko at the near post but it goes over.

According to recent reports, isak has the chance to potentially seal the victory for Liverpool but Le Normand makes a crucial block. Le Normand has only just come on but already made a couple of defensive actions.

According to recent reports, liverpool win a corner out on the left with the last touch coming off Pubill, who was marking Van Dijk from a free-kick. Szoboszlai’s inswinger is headed away by Le Normand.

Digeo Simeone is making his final two substitutions of the night as Le Normand and Hjulmad replace Romero and Barrios,.

Atletico bring on David, on loan from Juventus, for Baena.

In a recent development, alvarez has a chance inside the Liverpool box but his shot is straight at Alisson. There are some appeals for handball but it hit Munoz from such close range that it is never a penalty.

It has been revealed that liverpool are making a substitution as Mac Allister, who scored the goal to put Liverpool in front, is replaced by Gravenberch. Mac Allister, who made some comments in the press conference yesterday about his sadness at not being offered a new contract, put in a good performance in the centre of Liverpool’s midfield. He was on a booking though so probably sensible to take him off when you can guarantee that the Atletico players would have tried to get him sent off.

According to recent reports, we’ll see what happens in the coming weeks and months but there have been glimmers here with Florian Wirtz looking better than he has done with pace to pass to; if it clicks with him, Bradley Barcola & Alexander Isak it could be exciting but one game must be built on. It’s frustrating that Barcola’s night has ended with what appears to be cramp or tightness in his calf because he was getting more joy than he had done before half-time. The big challenge for Liverpool, too, is whether they have the nous to see this contest out.

The upcoming Netherlands boss Xavi is in attendance at Anfield tonight, watching the likes of Van Dijk, Frimpong and Gravenberch, although the latter is still yet to come off the Liverpool bench.

This is a concern for Liverpool. Barcola has gone down and seems to have some pain in his left calf. Is it cramp or an injury? It will be a double change for the home side as Frimpong and Munoz come on. Barcola is given a standing ovation as he goes off and the Liverpool fans will be hoping it is just cramp. Ngumoha also heads off.

Recent findings suggest that diego Simeone is going to make his first two changes of the night. Grimaldo and Lookman come on.

It is all Liverpool as they sense a third goal is there for the taking. Ngumoha does well down Liverpool’s left and pushes it past Pubill, who slides in and takes him down. Pubill is booked. He cannot believe it but I do not know why; a clear foul and yellow card.

Recent findings suggest that that is a stunning strike from the Argentine. The ball falls to the midfielder just outside the box and he hits it first time. He hits the ball so crisply and there is nothing Oblak can do to stop it. Liverpool should have taken the lead through Barcola moments before they do now have the lead for the first time tonight.

Industry observers note that mac Allister FIRES Liverpool into the lead at Anfield! 🔥📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/KGOvuAEU4W.

Industry observers note that well, that’s one way to prove you might warrant a newly introduced contract. A quite beautiful left footed drive from Alexis Mac Allister gives Liverpool the lead and it has been noticeable thus far in Andoni Iraola’s matches that his team get stronger at the start of the second period. Diego Simeone most wonder how Atleti are losing a game they were controlling but Liverpool’s speed on the break is proving very good at causing chaos.

It has been revealed that barcola should have his first Liverpool goal and the hosts should be ahead but the Frenchman misses the target. It is the perfect counter-attack really from Liverpool and it is Wirtz and Barcola who exchange passes from deep inside their own half all the way to the Atletico penalty area. Barcola drives forward, into the Atletico box, and you think he is going to slot it into the bottom corner but his effort goes just wide. Barcola could and perhaps should have a brace tonight.

Sources indicate that barcola wins the first corner of this second half off Hancko right in front of The Kop. Liverpol take it short before Mac Allister clips the ball in. Araujo meets it and his header is powerful but it is off target.

We are back under way at Anfield. No changes from either side at the break.

The first half at Anfield is brought to an end and it is level at 1-1 at the break. Llorente gave Atletico the lead before Szoboszlai equalised for Liverpool. The home fans let the officials know what they think of their performance in that first half.

One added minute at the end of this first half.

It has been revealed that there has been about five minutes of squabbling between the Liverpool and Atletico benches, so much so that Tommy Elphick - Andoni Iraola’s assistant - missed Dominik Szoboszlai score the equaliser. Tensions have only increased after a nasty little challenge from Cristian Romero on Alexander Isak. The half-time whistle might be coming at a good time to defuse the situation but you fancy the walk back to the dressing rooms will be spicy.

Sources indicate that the conduct of the Atletico players is frankly embarrassing, not a massive surprise from a Diego Simeone side. Kang goes down clutching his face when there was barely any contact and then, unlike Isak, he does not have to spend a minute off the pitch.

Isak is on the ground, clutching at his knee, after a heavy challenge from Romero. It is a nasty challenge from Romero, who remarkably is neither booked nor penalised. To compound the awful officiating, Isak now has to spend a minute off the pitch owing to the new rules. What do you make of that new rule of the player who is down going off for a minute? Have your say in the comments section at the bottom of the blog.

Moments after Liverpool equalised, Atletico have a decent opportunity to restore their lead but Baena drags his effort wide from the edge of the box.

In a recent development, moments after Barcola could not take a substantial chance to equalise for Liverpool, Szoboslzai does. First, Barcola is denied by Oblak. Liverpool keep it alive inside the Atletico box and a simple sensational flick by Aruajo finds Szoboszlai, who finds the bottom corner with a clinical finish. Kerkez has been poor tonight but he deserves credit for his part in that goal as he was the player to initially win it back for Liverpool with a good press.

According to recent reports, szoboszlai slots home after a brilliant flick from Araujo! 🔥📺 Watch live on TNT Sports & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/UrHQTwtgsY.

In a recent development, liverpool look like a team that has been out of the Champions League for a couple of years and are only just finding its feet, which seems strange given they missed only one year in the last 10. They have glimmers of promise but they aren’t convincing anyone they will blow Atleti’s house down. One day everything will align for Atleti and they will reach another final. They have an outside chance this year, especially if Julian Alvarez - easily the best player on this pitch - has anything to do with it. Diego Simeone always has class strikers at the top of his team and Alvarez stands comparison with any who have gone before.

In a recent development, wirtz has a great chance to equalise for Liverpool but his shot on the half volley is saved by Oblak. It would not have mattered anyway had the ball ended up in the net because Isak was offside before crossing for Wirtz.

Some of the officiating tonight has been appalling and the latest example is VAR taking a check on a possible red card for Mac Allister for a foul that is never a red card in a million years. The officials then take an age to give yet another obvious offside and, in the end, the referee gives it rather than the linesman. That really does sum up the officials tonight as the referee should not be the one to give offsides.

Sources indicate that alvarez shoots from distance and forces Alisson into a good save diving to his right. There was a suspicion of offside from Simeone in the build-up.

Atletico take it short but Simeone’s shot is blocked by Araujo.

According to recent reports, the Anfield faithful are furious. Two fouls in quick succession are not given when they were both clearly fouls. The referee appears to have a different interpretation of body checks and taking people out off the ball than the rest of us.

Recent findings suggest that the Spanish side take the lead at Anfield and it is another goal on this ground for Llorente. Alvarez feeds a through ball to pick out the run of Llorente, who is onside. He takes one touch before firing past Alisson from the edge of the box. That is poor, poor defending from Kerkez, who not only played Llorente onside but then did not track the run properly. Llorente now has five goals on this ground.

The idea that Atletico Madrid are focused on spoiling and nullifying belongs in the past. They are an attractive team, well organised and you suspect they have the gears to cause Liverpool problems... and as we type, they have just opened the scoring by playing straight through Liverpool’s middle. It was a bad goal for home side to concede. Milos Kerkez was out of sync with the rest of Liverpool’s defence and Marcos Llorente has galloped straight through. As we stated at the start: it’s a big test for the hosts... it’s just got even bigger.

A little line about Llorente, who has now scored five times against Liverpool in the Champions League. He is fond of playing in this arena, he named his dog “Anfield! when he bought it in 2021.

Chance for Barcola. Szoboszlai clips a lovely ball in behind down the right channel to pick out the run of Barcola. The Frenchman takes it down beautifully before having his shot saved by Oblak. Barcola’s best moment thus far tonight.

Baena takes a first-time effort on from a central position around 25 yards out but he cannot keep his effort down and it sails into The Kop.

In a recent development, atletico were renowned for years under Diego Simeone is being very tight at the back and in midfield, especially away from home. However, in recent years they have become more expansive and as a result are more open.

In a recent development, liverpool win their first corner of the night at the Anfield Road End in front of the travelling Atletico fans. They take it short and Szoboslzai takes it towards the Atletico box. It appeared to be a very obvious foul on Szoboszlai right on the edge of the box but nothing is given. At the very least, it should have been given a free-kick as there was definitely at least one foul.

Barcola, who has won the Champions League with PSG in the last two seasons, is starting out on the right for Liverpool tonight with Ngumoha on the left.

In a recent development, substantial test for Liverpool and it will be fascinating to see how this formation works out. It looks very much like it is 4-4-2, with Florian Wirtz almost alongside Alexander Isak and Rio Ngumoha the left winger and Bradley Barcola on the opposite flank - a position Andoni Iraola has referenced him playing in Lyon as a teenager. It’s also a big test for Iraola against Diego Simeone, the wily and vastly experienced manager, who is immaculately dressed - as always - in his trademark black suit.

Liverpool have a chance inside the opening minute. Szoboszlai wins it inside his own half and drives forward. He then plays it out to his right to find Isak, whose shot from the right side of the box is dragged wide of the far post. Isak did score from a similar position against Ipswich last Friday, when he scored at the near post.

A minute’s silence to remember the victims of the landslides in Nepal is impeccably observed.

We are under way at Anfield. Liverpool’s Champions League campaign gets going as Andoni Iraola takes charge of his first game as a manager in this competition.

According to recent reports, the two sides emerge from the tunnel to a cacophony of noise and we are moments away from kick-off at Anfield. The home fans boo the Champions League anthem and belt out “Liverpool! Liverpool!” over the top of it. Here is a reminder of how the two sides line up this evening:.

The original “This is Anfield” sign has sold at auction for almost £150,000, 10 times more than its guide price.

The sign that hung above the players’ tunnel at Liverpool’s home stadium during the 1970s had been expected to fetch between £10,000 and £15,000 after being put up for auction on Tuesday and Wednesday.

But the “talismanic” piece of football memorabilia ended up being sold by auctioneer Budds for £149,500 to a UK private buyer.

Industry observers note that the Argentine is into the final two years of his contract, which runs out in 2028. He arrived at Liverpool in the same summer as fellow midfielders Ryan Gravenberch and Dominik Szoboszlai, who have both signed fresh contracts. Mac Allister was linked with a move away from Liverpool during the summer transfer window and was candid about his contractual situation in the press conference yesterday:.

“I received the news that the club was not in a position to offer me a latest contract which, of course, makes me very, very sad. Everyone can see that I give my 100% for this football club every single day in training and games. Of course, I can have very good games [and] bad games, like everyone, but I always give my best.

According to recent reports, “I see Dominik [Szoboszlai] and Ryan [Gravenberch] renewing their contracts and that makes me very happy because they deserve it. At the same time it makes me a little bit sad that I did not get mine. Of course, there is still time. The fans do not need to worry because I will give my 100% until the last day I am here. There were options to leave this summer. I think right now I am in the right club and I have the right mindset to give 100% for this club.”.

Former Liverpool manager Rafa Benitez, who led the club to Champions League glory on that famous night in Istanbul in 2005, is in attendance tonight. Andoni Iraola has just shared a hug with his compatriot and perhaps Benitez will have a few words of advice for Iraola ahead of his Champions League debut as a manager.

The Dutchman has been in fine form at the start of the season for Liverpool, registering a goal and three assists in his first three games. He missed training yesterday and is not in Liverpool’s matchday squad tonight. Andoni Iraola has confirmed that Gakpo has a small adductor injury that he picked up in the Ipswich game last Friday but could be fit for the weekend against Fulham.

This season’s Champions League final is in that very stadium and Liverpool’s Champions League campaign starts tonight against the club that plays their home games in that stadium, Atletico Madrid.

“This is going to be a challenge, I hope, all the season because it would mean we continue in all the competitions. In this case, it is not the worst scenario because we played last Friday so we have had I think a good recovery. Sources indicate that liverpool begin their Champions League campaign at home as they host Atletico Madrid at Anfield. These sides met at Anfield on matchday one last season, with Liverpool winning a dramatic game 3-2. Liverpool led 2-0 inside the opening 10 minutes before Atletico came back to level the game at 2-2. Virgil van Dijk then scored in added time to give Liverpool all three points before Atletico boss Diego Simeone was sent off for clashing with the Anfield crowd, resulting in a one-match ban.

Andoni Iraola earned his first win as Liverpool boss on Friday night as they won 2-0 away at Ipswich thanks to a quickfire early double from Alexander Isak. This will be Iraola’s first Champions League match as a manager.

“I think obviously it is a special night for me,” Iraola said. “Everyone talks [about] the Champions League nights at Anfield and also the first game is against a strong opposition, it is Atletico Madrid. [Diego] Simeone is doing an incredible job as a manager. To be all the years that he has been achieving every season the goals of the club I think is remarkable and definitely it is a massive challenge for us. I think I played against him as a player, he was still a player, and I played against his teams when he was a coach and I also coached against him. So, we had a lot of precedent before. Definitely he has much more experience than me in this kind of games but I hope tomorrow we can give him a good game.

Industry observers note that “It is one of the dreams, probably, when you start. It was difficult for me when I started my coaching career seven, eight years ago, to position myself in the position that I am right now, and I hope I can enjoy it. It is a big responsibility, massive challenge, but I feel privileged to be there in that dugout tomorrow [tonight] and now my thinking is about putting the team together in a position where we can play a good game, win the game and start strong in this Champions League.”.

Sources indicate that atletico Madrid right now sit sixth in La Liga and suffered their first defeat on Saturday as they lost 3-0 at Athletic Bilbao. They did reach the semi-finals of the Champions League last season, where they fell to Arsenal 2-1 on aggregate.

“We are coming into a marvellous stadium and there will be a great atmosphere,” Simeone remarked. “We will have to look good from the start of the game because it will be full on. He [Andoni Iraola] works very well with the team, focusing on the tactical awareness of each player. It takes time to find the right path, but he is growing and improving and he has some very good players.”.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sebastian Hoeness, allenatore dello Stoccarda, ha parlato in conferenza stampa alla vigilia dell'impegno di Champions League contro l'Inter. Qui le sue considerazioni: "Stiller? So che vorreste la formazione, lui ha recuperato ed è in grado di giocare, vale per tutti gli altri. Contro lo Schalke i ragazzi hanno fatto ciò che gli ho chiesto, soprattutto in alcune fasi della partita. Ci è mancato l'ultimo passaggio, non abbiamo fatto ottime scelte, ma abbiamo comunque creato diverse occasioni. Dobbiamo capire che se avessimo per caso segnato un gol l'impressione dei media sarebbe stata diversa. Veniamo da uno 0-0 e di sicuro vorremmo vincere di più e non perdere ancora tanti punti per strada. Abbiamo anche da pensare alla Champions League, ma avremmo dovuto avere almeno due punti in più in Europa se pensiamo a quanto fatto in casa dell'Atletico. La sfortuna ci ha accompagnato nel percorso, speriamo di riuscire a fare meglio domani".

Undav non ha brillato contro lo Schalke. "Non è solamente lui il tema, sono tutti sempre in discussione. Che lui polarizzi lo sappiamo, ma non voglio parlare di un singolo. Non abbiamo segnato contro lo Schalke, ma è una responsabilità che riguarda tutti".

According to recent reports, che impressione ti fa questo stadio?"Siamo contentissimi di essere qui, abbiamo fatto un giro nello stadio ed è stato impressionante. E' alto, enorme, come lo ricordavo quando l'ho visto da spettatore da adolescente. Guardo tante partite in tv, ho visto anche il derby. Questo stadio ha una storia pazzesca, incluso il capitolo dei mondiali del '90. Siamo felici di poter giocare qui ed essere parte della storia di questo stadio. E' fantastico anche senza tifosi, non vediamo l'ora di goderci l'atmosfera domani sera".

Che ricordi hai della prima partita vista qui?"Sì, di fatto ho visto qui la prima partita in cui ho preso consapevolezza del calcio. Abbiamo visto la partita della Germania qui nel '90 e da allora la passione è cresciuta dentro di me".

Recent findings suggest that ti aspettavi di venire qui ad affrontare l'Inter con un punto in più in classifica?"Devo essere molto sincero, era impossibile aspettarselo. siamo davanti e faremo di tutto perché l'Inter rimanga dietro. Ci vogliamo misurare contro loro, sono tra le più grandi squadre in Europa. Noi siamo in grado di tenere testa anche ad avversarie così forti".

Ha visto Atalanta-Inter?"Ho visto Atalanta-Inter live, ma anche altre partite in differita. L'Inter è organizzata benissimo, ha un grandissimo allenatore e grandi individualità. Riesce a trovare una commistione tra la grande organizzazione, con schemi molto chiari, e il valore dei singoli. Vedendola da lontano la vedo come un unico collettivo che funziona molto bene, ha tutte le corde accordate quando i singoli si muovono d'insieme".

Si parla delle amnesie difensive dell'Inter in Italia."Abbiamo visto che per l'Inter è insolito prendere così tanti gol, non so se ci siano falle strutturali. Non penso che l'Inter giocherà con la stessa difesa di Bergamo. Ci sono anche delle defezioni, ma hanno una squadra fantastica e noi dobbiamo mostrare di cosa siamo capaci, sfruttando magari i loro punti deboli. Vogliamo portare la nostra proposta di calcio, si tratterà di cogliere momenti che saranno magari più favorevoli per noi e sfruttarli al meglio".

Il momento dell'Inter può favorirvi in qualche modo?"Abbiamo visto tutti insieme la partita contro l'Atalanta, osservando i loro meccanismi e tenendo in considerazione ogni aspetto. Vediamo che cercano di giocare di sponda sulla punta, magari domani giocherà Lautaro, ma hanno anche grande tecnica da abbinare alla fisicità. Dimarco ha un piede sinistro che non devo neanche raccontarvi, per esempio. Abbiamo una grande sfida davanti a noi: tenere conto di tutte le componenti dell'Inter".

#95856. Martin Odegaard bails out comically wasteful Arsenal
